title: "I Am Entitled to Be Represented by Counsel"
hook: "I am entitled to be|represented by Counsel"

lines.say: The United States Supreme Court says I am entitled to be represented by Counsel.

scene.q: The United States Supreme Court says I am entitled to be represented by Counsel.
scene.cite: As quoted in Gideon v. Wainwright, 372 U.S. 335 (1963)

lines.say: Clarence Earl Gideon told a Florida judge that in nineteen sixty-one. Charged with breaking into a poolroom, too poor for a lawyer. The judge said no: Florida appointed counsel only in capital cases.
lines.show: Clarence Earl Gideon told a Florida judge that in 1961. Charged with breaking into a poolroom, too poor for a lawyer. The judge said no: Florida appointed counsel only in capital cases.

lines.say: He defended himself. Guilty. Five years.
Nineteen sixty-three: the Supreme Court ruled for him, without a dissent. Retried with a lawyer, he was acquitted.
lines.show: 1963: the Supreme Court ruled for him, without a dissent. Retried with a lawyer, he was acquitted.

lines.say: Real trials. Real evidence. The verdict.
